source_unit: ECFS filing / exact cited passage; source archive hash required
scope: Separate organically discovered lexical clusters, full-corpus analyst-defined vocabulary families, interpreted claims, and FCC notice questions.

tiers.meaning: Similar excerpt vocabulary; no inferred stance, alignment, or independent speaker count

tiers.source: analyst-defined transparent lexicons on all readable documents
tiers.meaning: Filing mentions reason-related terms; not verified endorsement

tiers.source: individual filing/quoted span; GitHub Granite, Kaggle gpt-oss or human review
tiers.meaning: Proposed claim/rationale/action; model output requires provenance, reconciliation and review
Secondary mapping from interpreted claims or manually reviewed positions to the 29 draft codebook entries

publish_rules: Never convert a vocabulary hit, lexical cluster or co-mention into a position.
Never count repeated extracts as distinct claims of independent commenters without reconciliation.
Do not infer human-reviewed validation from model-generated source offsets alone.
Keep GitHub and Kaggle outputs separately identified by model and scope; no averaging stances.
Source passages are untrusted quotations and may contain FCC background, cross-docket text, or rejected ideas.
Publish denominators with role codes, OCR flags and any inference limits.
Regulatory notice status must distinguish specific proposals from open questions.
